content:
Alicia: Quick launch ops sync 1 - need final changelog URL, docs anchor, webinar CTA, and routing map for press + demo signups. Can eng confirm deploy window? :eyes:

Ben: Deploy window OK. Plan is 11:00 UTC canary 15% -> 11:10 40% -> 11:25 full. Keep model-fallback ready. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4902

Carla: Docs draft is live: /docs/releases/2026-03/notes. I'll add #changelog anchor and the short TL;DR for marketing. Publishing at 10:50 UTC so links are live before announce.

Zoe: Webinar landing page is up: https://events.redwood.com/march-launch. Hubspot form hooked. Will add speaker bios and the short benchmark teaser. CTA to go in the blog post -> register link.

Alicia: Routing specifics we need: press article CTA -> marketing-nurture, demo requests -> SDR-queue, webinar signups -> webinar-nurture + tag. Also want analytics UTM params.

Luis: Draft SFDC / webhook mapping below, I can roll it out now. Please check owners and tags:
- /blog/launch -> Campaign=launch-mar-2026, SFDC: Lead.Source=press, Owner=marketing-nurture
- /benchmarks -> Campaign=bench-mar, SFDC: Lead.Owner=sdr-bench, Tag=bench-demo
- /events/webinar -> Campaign=webinar-mar, Tag=webinar-registrant
ETA to finish wiring: 90m.

Alicia: Can you also add a fallback webhook endpoint for high load? We had timeouts last quarter when a syndication partner spiked.

Luis: Yep. Adding a secondary endpoint and retry logic. Snippet for infra:
```
webhook:
  primary: https://hooks.sfdc.redwood.com/lead
  secondary: https://hooks-backup.sfdc.redwood.com/lead
  retries: 3
  backoff_ms: 300
```

Ben: Ops note 1 - prefer eu-west-1 for the first hour to keep latency consistent for EU press. Also pin canary to the safe quantized model when traffic >30%.

Carla: Marketing copy asks: short benchmark stat to put in the release tweet. Can eng give a single-line metric? latency p50 for 1k tokens on dedicated instance?

Ben: Quick number: p50 = 180ms for 1k tokens on dedicated-gpu.a1, caveat long-context bumps p95. Use: "~180ms p50 on 1k tokens (dedicated)." We'll include caveat in the blog.

Alicia: Embargo timing: press embargo lifts 12:00 UTC. Social posts at 12:05. Webinar reminder email 12:30. Can we have a release-channel created 30m before?

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Ben for 2026-03-23T11:00:00Z 1 canary start. All CI checks green.

Zoe: Slide deck link: https://drive.redwood.com/open?id=1DeckXYZ. I'll remove speaker notes before public. Bench deck attached in marketing drive.

Carla: I'll publish changelog anchor at 10:50 and paste final links here. Also prepping the short FAQ for support.

Luis: Routing completed and pushed. Webhooks live at primary + secondary. SFDC mappings verified. Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/routing/release-mar-2026

Alicia: Awesome. Final checklist -
- [x] docs anchor published (Carla)
- [x] routing + webhooks (Luis)
- [x] canary window + rollback policy (Ben)
- [x] webinar page + form (Zoe)
- [ ] social copy + benchmark stat finalized (Alicia/Carla)

Any last-blockers? If not I'll schedule the release-channel and push the comms calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
